# roms.in — 판독 구간 기록

판독 대상은 1행부터 3578행까지다. 빈 줄과 주석 구분선도 구간에 포함한다. 한국어 설명과 원문 인용을 구분한다. 원문 인용은 입력값과 설명 주석의 표기를 유지한다.

| 구간 | 내용 |
|---|---|
| 1–64 | ROMS 표준 입력 형식 — 키워드 뒤의 `=`·`==`, 주석, 빈 줄, 역슬래시 연속행, 배열 값 반복을 설명한다(2–35). `AKT_BAK` 중첩 격자 예시의 두 값 배치를 설명한다(24–28). 여러 NetCDF 파일의 세로줄 연결 예시에서 `NFFILES`는 파일 항목 수가 아니라 서로 다른 입력장 수라고 적는다(37–61). 원문: `! For example, the USER may have different data for the` (1182); `! wind products, heat fluxes, etc. Alternatively, if the all the forcing` (1183); `! files are the same for nesting and the data is in its native resolution,` (1184); `! we could enter only one set of files names and ROMS will replicate those` (1185); `! files internally to the remaining grids using the plural KEYWORD protocol.` (1186); `! The model will scan the files and will read the needed data from the first` (1188); `! file in the list containing the forcing field. Therefore, the order of the` (1189); `! filenames is critical. If using multiple forcing files per grid, first` (1190); `! enter all the file names for grid one followed by two, and so on. | 1227–1247 | 용어집(GLOSSARY) / 제목·전처리·변수 정보 — 제목과 C 전처리 플래그의 문자열 제한 및 정의를 제시한다(1228–1238). 변수 정보 파일명의 문자열 제한을 제시한다(1241). 이 파일을 먼저 처리하여 `mod_ncparam.F` 정보 배열과 인덱스를 초기화해야 한다고 적는다(1244–1246). 원문: `!  GLOSSARY:` (1228); `! Application title (string with a maximum of 80 characters) and` (1232); `! C-preprocessing flag.` (1233); `! TITLE        Application title.` (1236); `! MyAppCPP     Application C-preprocessing option.` (1238); `! Variable information filename (string with a maximum of 256 characters).` (1241); `! VARNAME      Input/Output variable information filename.  This file needs to` (1244); `!                be processed first so all information arrays and indices can` (1245); `!                be initialized properly in "mod_ncparam.F".` (1246). |
| 1248–1306 | 용어집 / 중첩 격자와 처리 순서 — 격자 수를 다른 매개변수보다 먼저 읽어야 한다고 적는다(1249–1253). 중첩 층과 층별 격자 수의 관계식, 비중첩 설정, WikiROMS 링크를 제시한다(1255–1274). `main3d` 층·시간·격자 반복 예시와 `GridNumber` 배열에 따른 계산 순서 및 즉석 계산 예시를 그대로 포함한다(1276–1305). 외부 도식의 URL은 적혀 있지만 이 구간에는 그림 파일명이나 이미지 지시문이 없다(1257–1260·1272). 원문: `! Nested grid parameters (processing order of these parameters is important).` (1249); `! Ngrids       Number of nested grids. It needs to be read before all other` (1252); `!                parameters in order to allocate all model variables.` (1253); `! NestLayers   Number of grid nesting layers. It is used to allow applications` (1255); `!                with both composite and refinement grid combinations, as shown` (1256); `!                in WikiROMS diagrams for the Refinement and Partial Boundary` (1257); `!                Composite Sub-Classes. See,` (1258); `!                https://www.myroms.org/wiki/index.php/Nested_Grids` (1260); `!                In non-nesting applications, set NestLayers = 1.` (1262); `! GridsInLayer Number of grids in each nested layer, a vector of size` (1264); `!                [1:NestLayers]. Notice that,` (1265); `!                SUM(GridsInLayer)    = Ngrids` (1267); `!                LENGHT(GridsInLayer) = NestLayers` (1268); `!                The order of grids and nesting layers is extremely important.` (1270); `!                It determines the order of the sequential solution at every` (1271); `!                sub-timestep.  See WikiROMS nesting Sub-Classes diagrams.` (1272); `!                In non-nesting applications, set GridsInLayer = 1.` (1274); `!                NOTE:  In main3d, we use these parameters to determine which` (1276); `!                ====   grid index, ng, to solve when calling the routines of` (1277); `!                       the computational kernel:` (1278); `!                  NEST_LAYER : DO nl=1,NestLayers` (1280); `!                    ...` (1281); `!                    STEP_LOOP : DO istep=1,Nsteps` (1282); `!                      ...` (1283); `!                      DO ig=1,GridsInLayer(nl)` (1284); `!                        ng=GridNumber(ig,nl)` (1285); `!                        ...` (1286); `!                      END DO` (1287); `!                      ...` (1288); `!                    END DO STEP_LOOP` (1289); `!                  END DO NEST_LAYER` (1290); `!                Here, the grid order "ng" for the computations is determined` (1292); `!                from array "GridNumber", which is computed at initialization` (1293); `!                in "read_phypar.F". It can be computed on the fly as:` (1294); `!                  ng=Ngrids+1` (1296); `!                  DO j=NestLayers,nl,-1` (1297); `!                    DO i=GridsInLayer(j),1,-1` (1298); `!                      ng=ng-1` (1299); `!                      IF ((j.eq.nl).and.(i.eq.ig)) EXIT` (1300); `!                    END DO` (1301); `!                  END DO` (1302); `!                but it is too inefficient. This information is provided here` (1304); `!                to help you configure the order of nested grids.` (1305). |
| 1307–1355 | 용어집 / 격자 차원과 도식 — 격자 차원의 동적 메모리 할당(dynamic allocation) 처리 순서를 설명한다(1311–1313). 실제 응용에서 차원을 변경하면 모든 입력 NetCDF 파일을 다시 만들어야 한다고 적는다(1315–1318). `Lm`·`Mm`·`N`·`Nbed` 정의와 NetCDF 차원 관계, 인덱스 범위 및 옵션 조건을 제시한다(1320–1336). ASCII 도식은 수평 내부·외부 격자 범위, 수직 RHO·W 층, `h(i,j)`와 퇴적층 위치를 표시한다(1338–1354). 원문: `! Grid dimension parameters.` (1308); `! These parameters are very important since they determine the grid of the` (1311); `! application to solve. They need to be read first in order to dynamically` (1312); `! allocate all model variables.` (1313); `! WARNING: It is trivial and possible to change these dimension parameters in` (1315); `! -------  idealized applications via analytical expressions.  However, in` (1316); `! realistic applications any change to these parameters requires redoing all` (1317); `! input NetCDF files.` (1318); `! Lm           Number of INTERIOR grid RHO-points in the XI-direction for` (1320); `!                each nested grid, [1:Ngrids]. If using NetCDF files as` (1321); `!                input, Lm=xi_rho-2 where "xi_rho" is the NetCDF file` (1322); `!                dimension of RHO-points. Recall that all RHO-point` (1323); `!                variables have a computational I-range of [0:Lm+1].` (1324); `! Mm           Number of INTERIOR grid RHO-points in the ETA-direction for` (1326); `!                each nested grid, [1:Ngrids]. If using NetCDF files as` (1327); `!                input, Mm=eta_rho-2 where "eta_rho" is the NetCDF file` (1328); `!                dimension of RHO-points. Recall that all RHO-point` (1329); `!                variables have a computational J-range of [0:Mm+1].` (1330); `! N            Number of vertical terrain-following levels at RHO-points,` (1332); `!                [1:Ngrids].` (1333); `! Nbed         Number of sediment bed layers, [1:Ngrids]. This parameter` (1335); `!                is only relevant if CPP option SEDIMENT is activated.` (1336); `!                Mm+1  ___________________                _______  Kw = N` (1338); `!                     \|                   \|              \|       \|` (1339); `!                  Mm \|   _____________   \|              \|       \| Kr = N` (1340); `!                     \|  \|             \|  \|              \|_______\|` (1341); `!                     \|  \|             \|  \|              \|       \|` (1342); `!                  Jr \|  \|             \|  \|              \|       \|` (1343); `!                     \|  \|             \|  \|              \|_______\|` (1344); `!                     \|  \|             \|  \|              \|       \|` (1345); `!                   1 \|  \|_____________\|  \|              \|       \|` (1346); `!                     \|                   \|              \|_______\|` (1347); `!                   0 \|___________________\|              \|       \|` (1348); `!                              Ir                        \|       \| 1` (1349); `!                     0  1            Lm  Lm+1    h(i,j) \|_______\|` (1350); `!                                                        ::::::::: 0` (1351); `!                                                        :::::::::` (1352); `!                                                        ::::::::: Nbed-1` (1353); `!                                                        ::::::::: Nbed` (1354). |
| 1356–1373 | 용어집 / 추적자 수 — 활성·불활성·점착성 및 비점착성 퇴적물 추적자 수의 정의와 CPP 적용 조건을 제시한다(1356–1369). 총 퇴적물 추적자 수 관계식과 양수 조건을 제시한다(1371–1372). 원문: `! NAT          Number of active tracer type variables. Usually, NAT=2 for` (1356); `!                potential temperature and salinity.` (1357); `! NPT          Number of inert (dyes, age, etc) passive tracer type variables` (1359); `!                to advect and diffuse only. This parameter is only relevant` (1360); `!                if CPP option T_PASSIVE is activated.` (1361); `! NCS          Number of cohesive (mud) sediment tracer type variables. This` (1363); `!                parameter is only relevant if CPP option SEDIMENT is` (1364); `!                activated.` (1365); `! NNS          Number of non-cohesive (sand) sediment tracer type variables.` (1367); `!                This parameter is only relevant if CPP option SEDIMENT is` (1368); `!                activated.` (1369); `!                The total number of sediment tracers is NST=NCS+NNS.  Notice` (1371); `!                that NST must be greater than zero (NST>0).` (1372). |
| 1374–1396 | 용어집 / 영역 타일 분할 — 직렬·병렬 타일 분할(tile decomposition)과 범위 인덱스를 설명한다(1378–1381). 방향별 분할 수의 하한과 OpenMP 스레드 수·MPI 병렬 노드 수에 대한 서로 다른 곱 조건을 제시한다(1383–1395). 원문: `! Domain tile partition parameters.` (1375); `! Model tile decomposition parameters for serial and parallel configurations` (1378); `! which are used to determine tile horizontal range indices (Istr,Iend and` (1379); `! Jstr,Jend). In some computers, it is advantageous to have tile partitions` (1380); `! in serial applications.` (1381); `! NtileI       Number of domain partitions in the I-direction (XI-coordinate).` (1383); `!                It must be equal to or greater than one.` (1384); `! NtileJ       Number of domain partitions in the J-direction (ETA-coordinate).` (1386); `!                It must be equal to or greater than one.` (1387); `! WARNING:     In shared-memory (OpenMP), the product of NtileI and NtileJ must` (1389); `!              be a MULTIPLE of the number of parallel threads specified with` (1390); `!              the OpenMP environmental variable OMP_NUM_THREADS.` (1391); `!              In distributed-memory (MPI), the product of NtileI and NtileJ` (1393); `!              must be EQUAL to the number of parallel nodes specified during` (1394); `!              execution with the "mprun" or "mpirun" command.` (1395). |
| 1397–1445 | 용어집 / 추적자 이류 방법 — 양의 염분·불활성·생물·퇴적물장에는 양수 보존(positive-definite)·단조(monotonic) 방법이 적합하며 음·양 온도장에는 다른 방법이 더 적합하다고 적는다(1401–1407). 키워드별 알고리즘과 방향을 제시한다(1409–1424). HSIMT·MPDATA에서는 단조성 보존을 위해 수평·수직에 같은 방법을 써야 한다고 적는다(1426–1428). 비선형·수반 입력 배열의 정의를 포함한다(1430–1444). 원문: `! Tracer advection scheme` (1398); `! It is more advantageous to set the horizontal and vertical advection schemes` (1401); `! for each tracer with switches instead of a single CPP flag for all of them.` (1402); `! Positive-definite and monotonic algorithms (i.e., MPDATA and HSIMT) are` (1403); `! appropriate and useful for positive fields like salinity, inert, biological,` (1404); `! and sediment tracers.  However, since the temperature has a dynamic range` (1405); `! with negative and positive values in the ocean, other advection schemes are` (1406); `! more appropriate.` (1407); `! Currently, the following tracer advection schemes are available and are` (1409); `! activated using the associated Keyword:` (1410); `!   Keyword    Advection Algorithm` (1412); `!   A4         4th-order Akima (horizontal/vertical)` (1414); `!   C2         2nd-order centered differences (horizontal/vertical)` (1415); `!   C4         4th-order centered differences (horizontal/vertical)` (1416); `!   HSIMT      3th-order HSIMT with TVD limiter (horizontal/vertical)` (1417); `!   MPDATA     recursive flux corrected MPDATA (horizontal/vertical)` (1418); `!   SPLINES    parabolic splines reconstruction (only vertical)` (1419); `!   SU3        split third-order upstream (horizontal/vertical)` (1420); `!   U3         3rd-order upstresm-bias (only horizontal)` (1421); `! The user has the option of specifying the full Keyword or the first` (1423); `! two letters, regardless if using uppercase or lowercase.` (1424); `! If using either HSIMT (Wu and Zhu, 2010) or MPDATA (Margolin and` (1426); `! Smolarkiewicz, 1998) options, the user needs to set the same scheme` (1427); `! for both horizontal and vertical advection to preserve monotonicity.` (1428); `! Hadvection     Horizontal advection for each active (temperature and` (1430); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids]` (1431); `!                  values are expected.` (1432); `! Vadvection     Vertical advection for each active (temperature and` (1434); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids]` (1435); `!                  values are expected.` (1436); `! ad_Hadvection  Horizontal advection for each active (temperature and` (1438); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers in the adjoint-based` (1439); `!                  algorithms, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids] values are expected.` (1440); `! ad_Vadvection  Vertical advection for each active (temperature and` (1442); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers in the adjoint-based` (1443); `!                  algorithms, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids] values are expected.` (1444). |
| 1446–1473 | 용어집 / 이류 입력 예시 — 온도·염분·두 불활성 추적자에 서로 다른 방법을 지정하는 입력 예시를 제시한다(1446–1456). 세 중첩 격자에서 온도·염분별 수평·수직 이류 방법을 지정하는 예시를 제시한다(1458–1472). 모든 예시 값과 연속행을 그대로 옮긴다. 원문: `! Examples:` (1446); `!  Hadvection == A4       \                     ! temperature` (1448); `!                MPDATA   \                     ! salinity` (1449); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! dye_01, inert(1)` (1450); `!                HSIMT                          ! dy2_02, inert(2)` (1451); `!  Vadvection == A4       \                     ! temperature` (1453); `!                MPDATA   \                     ! salinity` (1454); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! dye_01, inert(1)` (1455); `!                HSIMT                          ! dye_02, inert(2)` (1456); `! or in nested applications` (1458); `!  Hadvection == U3       \                     ! temperature, Grid 1` (1460); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 1` (1461); `!                U3       \                     ! temperature, Grid 2` (1462); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 2` (1463); `!                U3       \                     ! temperature, Grid 3` (1464); `!                HSIMT                          ! salinity,    Grid 3` (1465); `!  Vadvection == C4       \                     ! temperature, Grid 1` (1467); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 1` (1468); `!                C4       \                     ! temperature, Grid 2` (1469); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 2` (1470); `!                C4       \                     ! temperature, Grid 3` (1471); `!                HSIMT                          ! salinity,    Grid 3` (1472). |
| 1474–1538 | 용어집 / 측면 경계조건 — 구조화 배열(structured array)의 형태와 경사 경계조건(gradient boundary conditions) 지정 예시를 제시한다(1478–1491). 복합 키워드와 경계조건 표, ASCII 경계 도식 및 변수별 입력 배열 범위를 제시한다(1493–1520). 도식은 서쪽 1, 남쪽 2, 동쪽 3, 북쪽 4와 격자 인덱스를 표시한다(1505–1512). Stokes 속도 및 수반·접선 선형·표현자 모델의 경계 배열 범위를 포함한다(1522–1538). 원문: `! Lateral boundary conditions parameters.` (1475); `! The lateral boundary conditions are now specified with logical switches` (1478); `! instead of CPP flags to allow nested grid configurations. Their values are` (1479); `! loaded into structured array:` (1480); `!    LBC(1:4, nLBCvar, Ngrids)` (1482); `! where 1:4 are the number of boundary edges, nLBCvar are the number of LBC` (1484); `! state variables, and Ngrids is the number of nested grids. For Example, to` (1485); `! apply gradient boundary conditions we use:` (1486); `!    LBC(iwest,  isFsur, ng) % gradient` (1488); `!    LBC(ieast,  ...   , ng) % gradient` (1489); `!    LBC(isouth, ...   , ng) % gradient` (1490); `!    LBC(inorth, ...   , ng) % gradient` (1491); `! The lateral boundary conditions are entered with a keyword. This keyword` (1493); `! is case insensitive and usually has three characters. However, it is` (1494); `! possible to have compound keywords, if applicable. For example, the` (1495); `! keyword "RadNud" implies radiation boundary condition with nudging. This` (1496); `! combination is usually used in active/passive radiation conditions.` (1497); `!   Keyword    Lateral Boundary Condition Type` (1499); `!   Cha        Chapman_implicit (free-surface only)` (1501); `!   Che        Chapman_explicit (free-surface only)` (1502); `!   Cla        Clamped` (1503); `!   Clo        Closed` (1504); `!   Fla        Flather (2D momentum only)             _____N_____     j=Mm` (1505); `!   Gra        Gradient                              \|     4     \|` (1506); `!   Nes        Nested (refinement only)              \|           \|` (1507); `!   Nud        Nudging                             1 W           E 3` (1508); `!   Per        Periodic                              \|           \|` (1509); `!   Rad        Radiation                             \|_____S_____\|` (1510); `!   Red        Reduced Physics (2D momentum only)          2          j=1` (1511); `!   Shc        Shchepetkin (2D momentum only)       i=1         i=Lm` (1512); `! LBC(isFsur) Free-surface,  [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1514); `! LBC(isUbar) 2D U-momentum, [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1515); `! LBC(isVbar) 2D V-momentum, [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1516); `! LBC(isUvel) 3D U-momentum, [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1517); `! LBC(isVvel) 3D V-momentum, [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1518); `! LBC(isMtke) Mixing TKE,    [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1519); `! LBC(isTvar) Tracers,       [1:4, 1:NAT+NPT, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1520); `! WEC boundary conditions for Stokes velocities:` (1522); `! LBC(isU2Sd) 2D U-Stokes,   [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1524); `! LBC(isV2Sd) 2D V-Stokes,   [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1525); `! LBC(isU3Sd) 3D U-Stokes,   [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1526); `! LBC(isV3Sd) 3D V-Stokes,   [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1527); `! Similarly, the adjoint-based algorithms (ADM, TLM, RPM) can have different` (1529); `! lateral boundary conditions keywords:` (1530); `! ad_LBC(isFsur) Free-surface,  [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1532); `! ad_LBC(isUbar) 2D U-momentum, [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1533); `! ad_LBC(isVbar) 2D V-momentum, [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1534); `! ad_LBC(isUvel) 3D U-momentum, [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1535); `! ad_LBC(isVvel) 3D V-momentum, [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1536); `! ad_LBC(isMtke) Mixing TKE,    [1:4, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1537); `! ad_LBC(isTvar) Tracers,       [1:4, 1:NAT+NPT, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1538). |
| 1539–1555 | 용어집 / 경계 체적 보존 — 비선형·수반 모델의 전역 질량 보존(global mass conservation)용 경계별 스위치를 정의한다(1540–1554). 조석 강제력이 활성화되면 이 스위치를 활성화하지 말라고 적는다(1542–1544). 원문: `! Lateral open boundary edge volume conservation switch for nonlinear model` (1540); `! and adjoint-based algorithm. Usually activated with radiation boundary` (1541); `! conditions to enforce global mass conservation. Notice that these switches` (1542); `! should not be activated if tidal forcing is enabled, [1:Ngrids] values are` (1543); `! expected.` (1544); `! VolCons(west)       Western  boundary volume conservation switch.` (1546); `! VolCons(east)       Eastern  boundary volume conservation switch.` (1547); `! VolCons(south)      Southern boundary volume conservation switch.` (1548); `! VolCons(north)      Northern boundary volume conservation switch.` (1549); `! ad_VolCons(west)    Western  boundary volume conservation switch.` (1551); `! ad_VolCons(east)    Eastern  boundary volume conservation switch.` (1552); `! ad_VolCons(south)   Southern boundary volume conservation switch.` (1553); `! ad_VolCons(north)   Northern boundary volume conservation switch.` (1554). |
| 1556–1579 | 용어집 / 시간 적분 — 3차원·2차원 설정에 따른 경압(baroclinic)·순압(barotropic) 시간 간격의 수와 초 단위를 정의한다(1560–1566). 2차원에서는 시간 분리가 필요 없으므로 `NDTFAST`를 일로 두라고 적는다(1568–1570). 관측 영향 분석·예측 시간 간격 수의 CPP 적용 조건을 제시한다(1572–1578). 원문: `! Timestepping parameters.` (1557); `! NTIMES       Total number of timesteps in current run.  If 3D configuration,` (1560); `!                NTIMES is the total of baroclinic timesteps.  If only 2D` (1561); `!                configuration, NTIMES is the total of barotropic timesteps.` (1562); `! DT           TimeStep size in seconds.  If 3D configuration, DT is the` (1564); `!                size of the baroclinic timestep.  If only 2D configuration,` (1565); `!                DT is the size of the barotropic timestep.` (1566); `! NDTFAST      Number of barotropic timesteps between each baroclinic time` (1568); `!                step. If only 2D configuration, NDTFAST should be unity since` (1569); `!                there is no need to split timestepping.` (1570); `! NTIMES_ANA   Total number of timesteps for computing observations impacts` (1572); `!                interval during the analysis cycle. It is only used when` (1573); `!                RBL4DVAR_FCT_SENSITIVITY is activated.` (1574); `! NTIMES_FCT   Total number of timesteps for computing observations impacts` (1576); `!                interval during the forecast cycle. It is only used when` (1577); `!                RBL4DVAR_FCT_SENSITIVITY is activated.` (1578). |
| 1580–1619 | 용어집 / 반복·시간 구간 분할 — 앙상블(ensemble) 시작·종료, 4D-Var 외부·내부 반복 상한과 Saddle-Point 4D-Var의 시간 병렬화(time parallelization) 구간 수를 정의한다(1584–1600). 적법 계산용 `MOD` 조건을 제시한다(1596–1600). 확률 최적의 시간 분할 설명과 예시 도식을 제시한다(1602–1618). 도식은 첫 시각·두 분할 시각·종료 시각을 표시하며 반복별 TLM 전방 적분과 ADM 후방 적분의 구간을 설명한다(1608–1618). 원문: `! Model iteration loops parameters.` (1581); `! ERstr        Starting ensemble run (perturbation or iteration) number.` (1584); `! ERend        Ending   ensemble run (perturbation or iteration) number.` (1586); `! Nouter       Maximum number of 4DVAR outer loop iterations.` (1588); `! Ninner       Maximum number of 4DVAR inner loop iterations.` (1590); `! Nsaddle      Number of kernel trajectory intervals for the solution of the` (1592); `!                Saddle-Point 4D-Var (SP4DVAR). It is used to accelerate` (1593); `!                4D-Var by parallelizing the inner loops in time. The tangent` (1594); `!                linear and adjoint models are time-stepped concurrently over` (1595); `!                the short time integration windows.  Make sure that` (1596); `!                  MOD(NTIMES/NHIS, Nsaddle) = 0` (1598); `!                for legal computations.` (1600); `! Nintervals   Number of time interval divisions for Stochastic Optimals` (1602); `!                computations. It must be a multiple of NTIMES. The tangent` (1603); `!                linear model (TLM) and the adjoint model (ADM) are integrated` (1604); `!                forward and backward at different intervals.  For example,` (1605); `!                if Nintervals=3,` (1606); `!              1               NTIMES/3         2*NTIMES/3           NTIMES` (1608); `!              +..................+..................+..................+` (1609); `!              <========================================================> (1)` (1610); `!                                 <=====================================> (2)` (1611); `!                                                    <==================> (3)` (1612); `!              In the first iteration (1), the TLM is integrated forward from` (1614); `!              1 to NTIMES and the ADM is integrated backward from NTIMES to 1.` (1615); `!              In the second iteration (2), the TLM is integrated forward from` (1616); `!              NTIMES/3 to NTIMES and the ADM is integrated backward from` (1617); `!              NTIMES to NTIMES/3. And so on.` (1618). |
| 1620–1645 | 용어집 / 고유값 문제(eigenproblem) — 고유값 수에 따른 메모리 증가와 상태벡터 복사 수를 설명한다(1624–1628). `NCV > NEV`의 형식적 조건과 최적 섭동(optimal perturbations) 권고, 유한시간 고유모드(Finite Time Eigenmodes, FTE)·수반 유한시간 고유모드(Adjoint Finite Time Eigenmodes, AFTE)의 조건을 구분한다(1630–1638). 고유값 수에 따른 효율과 시작값 권고를 제시한다(1640–1644). 원문: `! Eigenproblem parameters.` (1621); `! NEV          Number of eigenvalues to compute for the Lanczos/Arnoldi` (1624); `!                problem.  Notice that the model memory requirement increases` (1625); `!                substantially as NEV increases.  The GST requires NEV+1` (1626); `!                copies of the model state vector.  The memory requirements` (1627); `!                are decreased in distributed-memory applications.` (1628); `! NCV          Number of eigenvectors to compute for the Lanczos/Arnoldi` (1630); `!                problem. NCV must be greater than NEV.` (1631); `!  At present, there is no apriori analysis to guide the selection of NCV` (1633); `!  relative to NEV.  The only formal requirement is that NCV > NEV. However` (1634); `!  in optimal perturbations, it is recommended to have NCV greater than or` (1635); `!  equal to 2*NEV. In Finite Time Eigenmodes (FTE) and Adjoint Finite Time` (1636); `!  Eigenmodes (AFTE) the requirement is to have NCV greater than or equal to` (1637); `!  2*NEV+1.` (1638); `!  The efficiency of calculations depends critically on the combination of` (1640); `!  NEV and NCV.  If NEV is large (greater than 10 say), you can use NCV=2*NEV+1` (1641); `!  but for NEV small (less than 6) it will be inefficient to use NCV=2*NEV+1.` (1642); `!  In complicated applications, you can start with NEV=2 and NCV=10. Otherwise,` (1643); `!  it will iterate for a very long time.` (1644). |
| 1646–1678 | 용어집 / 재시작·관측소·부표·정보 출력 — `NRREC`의 신규 해·기록 인덱스·최신 기록 재시작 조건을 제시한다(1650–1655). 이력 재시작 파일에는 모든 층의 필요한 기본변수(primitive variables)가 있어야 한다고 적는다(1656–1659). 재시작의 최신 두 기록 유지·전체 저장·배정밀도(double precision)와 출력 중지 조건을 설명한다(1661–1668). 관측소·부표·표준 출력과 전역 에너지 진단의 간격을 정의한다(1670–1677). 원문: `! Input/Output parameters.` (1647); `! NRREC        Switch to indicate re-start from a previous solution.  Use` (1650); `!                NRREC=0 for new solutions. In a re-start solution, NRREC` (1651); `!                is the time index of the re-start NetCDF file assigned for` (1652); `!                initialization.  If NRREC is negative (say NRREC=-1), the` (1653); `!                model will re-start from the most recent time record. That` (1654); `!                is, the initialization record is assigned internally.` (1655); `!                Notice that it is also possible to re-start from a history` (1656); `!                or time-averaged NetCDF file.  If a history file is used` (1657); `!                for re-start, it must contains all the necessary primitive` (1658); `!                variables at all levels.` (1659); `! LcycleRST    Logical switch (T/F) used to recycle time records in output` (1661); `!                restart file.  If TRUE,  only the latest two re-start time` (1662); `!                records are maintained.  If FALSE, all re-start fields are` (1663); `!                saved every NRST timesteps without recycling.  The restart` (1664); `!                fields are written at all levels in double precision.` (1665); `! NRST         Number of timesteps between the writing of re-start fields.` (1667); `!                Set NRST=0 to suppress writing of RESTART file.` (1668); `! NSTA         Number of timesteps between writing data into STATIONS file.` (1670); `!                Station data is written at all levels.` (1671); `! NFLT         Number of timesteps between writing data into FLOATS file.` (1673); `! NINFO        Number of timesteps between the print of single line information` (1675); `!                to standard output.  It also determines the interval between` (1676); `!                computation of global energy diagnostics.` (1677). |
| 1679–1728 | 용어집 / 순간 출력·이력·추출·빠른 저장 — HISTORY·QUICKSAVE의 순간장(instantaneous fields) 출력 간격·파일 크기 활용을 설명한다(1683–1689). 재시작 때 새 파일 생성 또는 기존 파일 추가의 조건을 제시한다(1692–1699). 이력·추출·빠른 저장 파일의 기록·분할·출력 중지 조건과 `GRID_EXTRACT` 적용 조건을 제시한다(1701–1727). 원문: `!  Output HISTORY, QUICKSAVE, AVERAGE and DIAGNOSTIC files parameters.` (1680); `!  Notice that it is possible to have two types of output NetCDF files for` (1683); `!  instantaneous fields: HISTORY and QUICKSAVE. The QUICKSAVE file can be used` (1684); `!  for writing fewer fields at shorter time intervals. For example, the User` (1685); `!  may just write 2D and surface fields frequently (hourly) to reduce file` (1686); `!  size and to time resolve fast dynamics. In conjunction, the User may write` (1687); `!  full HISTORY fields infrequently (daily, weekly, etc) to avoid creating` (1688); `!  large output files. This gives a lot of flexibility to manage ROMS output.` (1689); `! LDEFOUT      Logical switch (T/F) used to create new output files when` (1692); `!                initializing from a re-start file, abs(NRREC) > 0.  If TRUE` (1693); `!                and applicable, a new HISTORY, QUICKSAVE, AVERAGE, DIAGNOSTIC` (1694); `!                and STATIONS files are created during the initialization` (1695); `!                stage. If FALSE and applicable, data is appended to existing` (1696); `!                HISTORY, QUICKSAVE, AVERAGE, DIAGNOSTIC and STATIONS files.` (1697); `!                See also parameters NDEFHIS, NDEFQCK, NDEFAVG and NDEFDIA` (1698); `!                below.` (1699); `! NHIS         Number of timesteps between writing fields into the HISTORY` (1701); `!                 file. Set NHIS=0 to suppress writing of HISTORY file.` (1702); `! NDEFHIS      Number of timesteps between the creation of new HISTORY file.` (1704); `!                If NDEFHIS=0, the model will only process one HISTORY file.` (1705); `!                This feature is useful for extended simulations when HISTORY` (1706); `!                file get too large; it creates a new file every NDEFHIS` (1707); `!                timesteps.` (1708); `! NXTR         Number of timesteps between writing fields into the EXTRACT` (1710); `!                 file, if GRID_EXTRACT is activated. Set NXTR=0 to suppress` (1711); `!                 writing of EXTRACT file.` (1712); `! NDEFXTR      Number of timesteps between the creation of new EXTRACT file.` (1714); `!                If NDEFXTR=0, the model will only process one EXTRACT file.` (1715); `!                This feature is useful for extended simulations when EXTRACT` (1716); `!                file get too large; it creates a new file every EXTRACT` (1717); `!                timesteps.` (1718); `! NQCK         Number of timesteps between writing fields into QUICKSAVE file.` (1720); `!                Set NQCK=0 to suppress writing of QUICKSAVE file.` (1721); `! NDEFQCK      Number of timesteps between the creation of new QUICKSAVE file.` (1723); `!                If NDEFQCK=0, the model will only process one QUICKSAVE file.` (1724); `!                This feature is useful for extended simulations when QUICKSAVE` (1725); `!                file get too large; it creates a new file every NDEFQCK` (1726); `!                timesteps.` (1727). |
| 1729–1754 | 용어집 / 평균·진단 출력 — 시간 평균 및 진단 누적의 시작 시간 간격을 정의한다(1729–1743). 평균·진단 기록 간격과 출력 중지 및 새 파일 분할 조건을 제시한다(1732–1753). 원문: `! NTSAVG       Starting timestep for the accumulation of output time-averaged` (1729); `!                data.` (1730); `! NAVG         Number of timesteps between writing time-averaged data` (1732); `!                into AVERAGE file.  Averaged date is written for all fields.` (1733); `!                Set NAVG=0 to suppress writing of AVERAGE file.` (1734); `! NDEFAVG      Number of timesteps between the creation of new AVERAGE` (1736); `!                file.  If NDEFAVG=0, the model will only process one AVERAGE` (1737); `!                file.  This feature is useful for extended simulations when` (1738); `!                AVERAGE file get too large; it creates a new file every` (1739); `!                NDEFAVG timesteps.` (1740); `! NTSDIA       Starting timestep for the accumulation of output time-averaged` (1742); `!                diagnostics data.` (1743); `! NDIA         Number of timesteps between writing time-averaged diagnostics` (1745); `!                data into DIAGNOSTIC file.  Averaged date is written for all` (1746); `!                fields. Set NDIA=0 to suppress writing of DIAGNOSTIC file.` (1747); `! NDEFDIA      Number of timesteps between the creation of new time-averaged` (1749); `!                diagnostics file.  If NDEFDIA=0, the model will only process` (1750); `!                one DIAGNOSTICS file.  This feature is useful for long` (1751); `!                simulations when DIAGNOSTIC file get too large; it creates` (1752); `!                a new file every NDEFDIA timesteps.` (1753). |
| 1755–1786 | 용어집 / 접선 선형·수반 출력 — 최신 두 기록을 유지하거나 전체 기록을 저장하는 조건을 제시한다(1759–1776). 접선 선형·수반 기록 간격과 새 파일 생성 간격을 정의한다(1764–1785). 수반 스위치의 설명에서 쓰인 `tangent linear fields` 표현도 원문 그대로 포함한다(1773–1776). 원문: `!  Output tangent linear and adjoint model parameters.` (1756); `! LcycleTLM    Logical switch (T/F) used to recycle time records in output` (1759); `!                tangent linear file.  If TRUE, only the latest two time` (1760); `!                records are maintained.  If FALSE, all tangent linear fields` (1761); `!                are saved every NTLM timesteps without recycling.` (1762); `! NTLM         Number of timesteps between writing fields into tangent linear` (1764); `!                model file.` (1765); `! NDEFTLM      Number of timesteps between the creation of new tangent linear` (1767); `!                file. If NDEFTLM=0, the model will only process one tangent` (1768); `!                linear file. This feature is useful for extended simulations` (1769); `!                when output NetCDF files get too large; it creates a new file` (1770); `!                every NDEFTLM timesteps.` (1771); `! LcycleADJ    Logical switch (T/F) used to recycle time records in output` (1773); `!                adjoint file.  If TRUE, only the latest two time records are` (1774); `!                maintained.  If FALSE, all tangent linear fields are saved` (1775); `!                every NADJ timesteps without recycling.` (1776); `! NADJ         Number of timesteps between writing fields into the adjoint` (1778); `!                 model file.` (1779); `! NDEFADJ      Number of timesteps between the creation of the new adjoint` (1781); `!                file. If NDEFADJ=0, the model will only process one adjoint` (1782); `!                file. This feature is useful for extensive simulations when` (1783); `!                the output NetCDF files get too large; it creates a new file` (1784); `!                every NDEFADJ timesteps.` (1785). |
| 1787–1809 | 용어집 / 4D-Var 표면·경계 조정 간격 — 강한 제약(strong constraint) 4D-Var에서 초기 시각 외에도 표면 강제력과 개방 경계장을 조정할 수 있다고 적는다(1787–1808). 저장 기록 수 표현, 전체 시간 간격 수에 대한 약수 또는 초과 조건, 일정 보정의 단일 기록 조건 및 관련 CPP 옵션을 제시한다(1790–1797·1802–1808). 원문: `! NSFF         Number of timesteps between 4DVAR adjustment of surface forcing` (1787); `!                fluxes. In strong constraint 4DVAR, it is possible to adjust` (1788); `!                surface forcing at other time intervals in addition to initial` (1789); `!                time.  This parameter is used to store the appropriate number` (1790); `!                of surface forcing records in the output history NetCDF files:` (1791); `!                1+NTIMES/NSFF records. NSFF must be a factor of NTIMES or` (1792); `!                greater than NTIMES. If NSFF > NTIMES, only one record is` (1793); `!                stored in the NetCDF files and the adjustment is for constant` (1794); `!                forcing with constant correction. This parameter is only` (1795); `!                relevant in 4DVAR when activating either ADJUST_STFLUX or` (1796); `!                ADJUST_WSTRESS.` (1797); `! NOBC         Number of timesteps between 4DVAR adjustment of open boundary` (1799); `!                fields. In strong constraint 4DVAR, it is possible to adjust` (1800); `!                open boundaries at other time intervals in addition to initial` (1801); `!                time.  This parameter is used to store the appropriate number` (1802); `!                of open boundary records in the output history NetCDF files:` (1803); `!                1+NTIMES/NOBC records. NOBC must be a factor of NTIMES or` (1804); `!                greater than NTIMES. If NOBC > NTIMES, only one record is` (1805); `!                stored in the NetCDF files and the adjustment is for constant` (1806); `!                forcing with constant correction. This parameter is only` (1807); `!                relevant in 4DVAR when activating ADJUST_BOUNDARY.` (1808). |
| 1810–1837 | 용어집 / GST 분석·체크포인트 — 고유벡터별 파일, 재시작과 체크포인트(checkpointing) 저장·덮어쓰기 스위치를 정의한다(1814–1820). 최대 반복과 정기 저장 간격, 수렴 또는 최대 반복 도달 시 저장 의무 및 Ritz 벡터 재계산 용도를 설명한다(1822–1833). Ritz 값의 상대 정확도 정의를 포함한다(1835–1836). 원문: `!  Generalized Stability Theory (GST) analysis parameters.` (1811); `! LmultiGST    Logical switch (TRUE/FALSE) to write out one GST analysis` (1814); `!                eigenvector per history file.` (1815); `! LrstGST      Logical switch (TRUE/FALSE) to restart GST analysis. If TRUE,` (1817); `!                the check pointing data is read in from the GST restart NetCDF` (1818); `!                file.  If FALSE and applicable, the checkpointing GST data is` (1819); `!                saved and overwritten every NGST iterations of the algorithm.` (1820); `! MaxIterGST   Maximum number of GST algorithm iterations.` (1822); `! NGST         Number of GST iterations between storing of check pointing` (1824); `!                data into NetCDF file. The restart data is always saved if` (1825); `!                MaxIterGST is reached without convergence. It is also saved` (1826); `!                when convergence is achieved. It is always a good idea to` (1827); `!                save the checkpointing data at regular intervals so there` (1828); `!                is a mechanism to recover from an unexpected interruption` (1829); `!                in this costly computation. The check pointing data can` (1830); `!                be used also to recompute the Ritz vectors by changing some` (1831); `!                of the parameters, like convergence criteria (Ritz_tol)` (1832); `!                and number of Arnoldi iterations (iparam(3)).` (1833); `! Ritz_tol     Relative accuracy of the Ritz values computed in the GST` (1835); `!                analysis.` (1836). |
| 1838–1894 | 용어집 / 수평 확산·점성 — 비선형·수반 추적자 조화·이중 조화 혼합계수 및 단위를 정의한다(1843–1869). 가변 수평 확산에서는 영역의 가장 큰 셀에 해당하는 계수라고 적는다(1845–1853·1857–1869). 운동량 계수와 가변 수평 점성 조건을 정의한다(1871–1893). 일부 수반 적용에서는 안정성을 위해 비선형 기본 상태보다 큰 값이 필요하다고 적는다(1859–1861·1867–1869·1884–1886·1891–1893). 원문: `! TNU4 is the mixing coefficient for the largest grid-cell` (1852); `!                in the domain.` (1853); `! ad_TNU2      Adjoint-based algorithms lateral, harmonic, constant, mixing` (1855); `!                coefficient (m2/s) for active (NAT) and inert (NPT) tracer` (1856); `!                variables. In some applications, a larger value than` (1859); `!                that used in the nonlinear model (basic state) is necessary` (1860); `!                for stability.` (1861); `! ad_TNU4      Adjoint-based algorithms lateral, biharmonic, constant, mixing` (1863); `!                coefficient (m4/s) for active (NAT) and inert (NPT) tracer` (1864); `!                variables. In some applications, a larger value than` (1867); `!                that used in the nonlinear model (basic state) is necessary` (1868); `!                for stability.` (1869); `! VISC2        Nonlinear model lateral, harmonic, constant, mixing` (1871); `!                coefficient (m2/s) for momentum. Many other stretching functions (Vstretching>5) are possible` (2245); `!              provided that:` (2246); `!                * C(s) is a dimensionless, nonlinear, monotonic function.` (2248); `!                * C(s) is a continuous differentiable function, or` (2249); `!                  a differentiable piecewise function with smooth transition.` (2250); `!                * The stretching vertical coordinate ,s, is constrained` (2251); `!                  between -1 <= s <= 0, with s=0 corresponding to the` (2252); `!                  free-surface and s=-1 corresponding to the bathymetry.` (2253); `!                * Similarly, the stretching function, C(s), is constrained` (2254); `!                  between -1 <= C(s) <= 0, with C(0)=0 corresponding to the` (2255); `!                  free-surface and C(-1)=-1 corresponding to the bathymetry.` (2256); `!              These functions are coded in routine "Utility/set_scoord.F".` (2258); `! Vstretching = 4` (2264); `! THETA_S      S-coordinate surface control parameter. The range of optimal` (2267); `!                values depends on the vertical stretching function, C(s).` (2268); `! THETA_B      S-coordinate bottom  control parameter. The range of optimal` (2270); `!                values depends on the vertical stretching function, C(s).` (2271); `! TCLINE       Critical depth (hc) in meters (positive) controlling the` (2273); `!                stretching. (levels) is required during stretching.` (2276). |

BVF_BAK     Background Brunt-Vaisala frequency squared (1/s2). Typical` (2285); `!              values for the ocean range (as a function of depth) from` (2286); `!              1.0E-4 to 1.0E-6.` (2287); `! Tide Genearting Forces (TGF) parameter.` (2290); `! Lnodal       Switch to account for the slow modulation of the equilibrium` (2293); `!                tides constituents due primarily to the 18.6-year lunar nodal` (2294); `!                cycle.` (2295). |
| 2297–2311 | 용어집 / 초기화 시간 — 초기화 시각의 일 단위 달력 좌표와 날짜별 값 예시를 제시한다(2301–2307). 절단 또는 수정 Julian 일(truncated or modified Julian day)에 더하는 오프셋을 제시한다(2309–2310). 모든 날짜·시각·수치를 원문 그대로 옮긴다. 원문: `! Time Stamps.` (2298); `! DSTART       Time stamp assigned to model initialization (days).  Usually` (2301); `!                a Calendar linear coordinate, like modified Julian Day.  For` (2302); `!                Example:` (2303); `!                         Julian Day    = 1      for  Nov 25, 00:00:00 4713 BCE` (2305); `!                modified Julian Day    = 1      for  May 24, 00:00:00 1968 GMT` (2306); `!                Days since Jan 1, 2000 = 988.5  for  Sep 15, 12:00:00 2002` (2307); `!                It is called truncated or modified Julian day because an` (2309); `!                offset of 2440000 needs to be added.` (2310). |
| 2312–2347 | 용어집 / 조석 영위상 기준 — `TIDE_START`의 단위와 영위상(zero phase) 정의 및 영 입력값의 의미를 제시한다(2312–2318). NetCDF `zero_phase_date` 변수의 형식·메타데이터 예시와 권장 추가 스크립트 및 실행 중 입력값 덮어쓰기 조건을 제시한다(2320–2336). 서로 다른 시간 기준과 음의 값 설명 및 `tide_start`·`omega` 식을 그대로 옮긴다(2338–2346). 원문: `! TIDE_START   Reference time origin for tidal forcing (days since application` (2312); `!                reference date, TIME_REF). It is defined as the time of phase` (2313); `!                zero when preparing the input forcing tidal boundary data. The` (2314); `!                tide reference time is important and often ignored parameter` (2315); `!                by the users. If TIDE_START=0.0, it implies that the date of` (2316); `!                zero phase is the same as the application date reference,` (2317); `!                TIME_REF.` (2318); `!                To avoid any ambiguity with the tide generating forcing in the` (2320); `!                pressure gradient, it is preferable if the "zero_phase_date"` (2321); `!                variable is available in the input tidal forcing NetCDF file.` (2322); `!                It is a floating-point variable of the form YYYYMMDD.dddd with` (2323); `!                the following metadata:` (2324); `!       double zero_phase_date` (2326); `!             zero_phase_date:long_name = "tidal reference date for zero phase"` (2327); `!             zero_phase_date:units = "days as %Y%m%d.%f"` (2328); `!             zero_phase_date:C_format = "%13.4f"` (2329); `!             zero_phase_date:FORTRAN_format = "(f13.4)"` (2330); `!                Use "forcing/add_tide_date.m" from the ROMS Matlab repository` (2332); `!                to add the "zero_phase_date" variable to your existing tidal` (2333); `!                forcing NetCDF file. It is highly recommended to use this` (2334); `!                approach. If such a variable is found, the TIDE_START value` (2335); `!                will overwritten during execution.` (2336); `!                Notice that it is possible to have different reference values` (2338); `!                for "zero_phase_date" and ROMS clock defined as seconds from` (2339); `!                reference date TIME_REF. If TIME_REF is earlier than variable` (2340); `!                "zero_phase_date", the frequencies (omega) to harmonic terms` (2341); `!                will be negative since they are computed as follows:` (2342); `!                tide_start = Rclock%tide_DateNumber(2) -` (2344); `!                             Rclock%DateNumber(2))` (2345); `!                omega = 2 * pi * (time - tide_start) / Tperiod` (2346). |
| 2348–2375 | 용어집 / 출력 시간 기준·달력 — 상대 시간과 NetCDF 단위 속성(units attribute)의 형식을 정의한다(2348–2352). 음·영·양의 `TIME_REF`에 따른 달력 조건과 단위 문자열 및 날짜·시각 예시를 그대로 옮긴다(2354–2374). 원문: `! TIME_REF     Reference time (yyyymmdd.f) used to compute relative time:` (2348); `!                elapsed time interval since reference-time.  The "units"` (2349); `!                attribute takes the form "time-unit since reference-time".` (2350); `!                This parameter also provides information about the calendar` (2351); `!                used:` (2352); `!                If TIME_REF = -2, model time and DSTART are in modified Julian` (2354); `!                days units.  The "units" attribute is:` (2355); `!                  'time-units since 1968-05-23 00:00:00 GMT'    (May 23, 1968)` (2357); `!                If TIME_REF = -1, model time and DSTART are in a calendar` (2359); `!                with 360 days in every year (30 days each month).  The "units"` (2360); `!                attribute is:` (2361); `!                  'time-units since 0000-12-30 00:00:00'        (Dec 30, 0000)` (2363); `!                If TIME_REF = 0, model time and DSTART are in a common year` (2365); `!                calendar with 365.25 days.  The "units" attribute is:` (2366); `!                  'time-units since 0001-01-01 00:00:00'        (Jan  1, 0001)` (2368); `!                If TIME_REF > 0, model time and DSTART are the elapsed time` (2370); `!                units since specified reference time.  For example,` (2371); `!                TIME_REF=20020115.5 will yield the following attribute:` (2372); `!                  'time-units since 2002-01-15 12:00:00'        (Jan 15, 2002)` (2374). |
| 2376–2397 | 용어집 / 너징 시간 척도·경계 배율 — 역시간 척도를 내부 계산한다고 적는다(2377). 수동·능동 개방 경계에서 입력값은 유출 시간 척도라고 적고 변수별 단위·배열 범위를 정의한다(2380–2390). 유입·유출 배율의 시간 척도 계산 설명과 유입이 더 강하다는 권고 조건을 그대로 옮긴다(2392–2396). 원문: `! Nudging/relaxation time scales, inverse scales will be computed internally.` (2377); `! When passive/active open boundary conditions are activated, these nudging` (2380); `! values correspond to the passive (outflow) nudging time scales.` (2381); `! TNUDG        Nudging time scale (days) for active tracer variables.` (2383); `!                (1:NAT+NPT,1:Ngrids) values are expected.` (2384); `! ZNUDG        Nudging time scale (days) for free-surface.` (2386); `! M2NUDG       Nudging time scale (days) for 2D momentum.` (2388); `! M3NUDG       Nudging time scale (days) for 3D momentum.` (2390); `! OBCFAC       Factor between passive (outflow) and active (inflow) open` (2392); `!                boundary conditions.  The nudging time scales for the` (2393); `!                active (inflow) conditions are obtained by multiplying` (2394); `!                the passive values by OBCFAC. If OBCFAC > 1, nudging on` (2395); `!                inflow is stronger than on outflow (recommended).` (2396). |
| 2398–2429 | 용어집 / 선형 상태방정식 — 압력을 무시하는 선형 밀도식과 각 연속행을 제시한다(2402–2405). 보통의 배경 밀도·온도·염분·팽창 및 수축 계수 값을 단위와 함께 제시한다(2407–2411). 염분은 전도도 비(conductivity ratio)로 정의하며 물리 단위가 없다고 적고 포럼 참조를 포함한다(2413–2417). 배경값과 열 팽창(thermal expansion)·염분 수축(saline contraction) 계수를 정의한다(2419–2428). 원문: `! Linear equation of State parameters.` (2399); `! Ignoring pressure, the linear equation of state is:` (2402); `!              rho(:,:,:) = R0 - R0 * TCOEF * (t(:,:,:,:,itemp) - T0)` (2404); `!                              + R0 * SCOEF * (t(:,:,:,:,isalt) - S0)` (2405); `!              Typical values:     R0 = 1027.0  kg/m3` (2407); `!                                  T0 = 10.0    Celsius` (2408); `!                                  S0 = 35.0    nondimensional` (2409); `!                               TCOEF = 1.7d-4  1/Celsius` (2410); `!                               SCOEF = 7.6d-4  1/nondimensional` (2411); `!              Notice that salinity has NO UNITS, it is nondimensional. Many` (2413); `!              people use PSU (Practical Salinity Unit).  However, salinity` (2414); `!              has always been defined as a conductivity ratio and does not` (2415); `!              have physical units. For details, check the following forum` (2416); `!              post:  www.myroms.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=30&t=294` (2417); `! R0           Background density value (Kg/m3) used in Linear Equation of` (2419); `!                State.` (2420); `! T0           Background potential temperature (Celsius) constant.` (2422); `! S0           Background salinity (nondimensional) constant.` (2424); `! TCOEF        Thermal expansion coefficient in Linear Equation of State.` (2426); `! SCOEF        Saline contraction coefficient in Linear Equation of State.` (2428). |
| 2430–2435 | 용어집 / 미끄럼 조건 — `GAMMA2`의 자유 미끄럼과 미끄럼 없음에 대응하는 두 값을 정의한다(2431–2434). 원문: `! Slipperiness parameter.` (2431); `! GAMMA2       Slipperiness variable, either 1.0 (free slip) or -1.0 (no slip).` (2434). |
| 2436–2501 | 용어집 / 점 공급원·제거원 스위치 — 수평 운동량·수직 체적 유입·추적자 활성화와 중첩 격자별 선택을 설명한다(2440–2469). 활성·불활성 추적자 인덱스 예시를 제시하고 생물·퇴적물 스위치는 별도 입력 스크립트에서 지정한다고 적는다(2455–2466). 모든 하천에 최소한 온도·염분이 필요하며 다른 추적자는 선택이라고 적는다(2471–2474). 대체한 `river_flag` 메타데이터 예시와 하위 호환(backward compatible) 설명을 제시한다(2476–2490). 추가 추적자가 불필요한 하천에도 영 값을 포함해 모든 하천 값을 지정해야 한다고 적는다(2492–2500). 원문: `! Point Sources/Sink sources activation switches.` (2437); `! LuvSrc       Logical switches (T/F) to activate momentum horizontal transport` (2440); `!                points Sources/Sinks. Usually it is used to turn on/off river` (2441); `!                runoff transport (u or v variables) in an application,` (2442); `!                [1:Ngrids].` (2443); `!                In nesting applications, turn on only the grids that require` (2445); `!                activation and processing of momentum point Sources/Sinks.` (2446); `! LwSrc        Logical switches (T/F) to activate mass points Sources/Sinks.` (2448); `!                Usually, it is used to turn on/off volume vertical influx (w)` (2449); `!                in an application.` (2450); `!                In nesting applications, turn on only the grids that require` (2452); `!                activation and processing of mass influx point Sources/Sinks.` (2453); `! LtracerSrc   Logical switches (T/F) to activate tracer variables point` (2455); `!                Sources/Sinks. Only NAT active tracers (temperature, salinity)` (2456); `!                and NPT inert tracers are activated here:` (2457); `!                 LtracerSrc(itemp,ng)     for temperature (itemp=1)` (2459); `!                 LtracerSrc(isalt,ng)     for salinity    (isalt=2)` (2460); `! At minimum, it is necessary to specify both` (2472); `!                temperature and salinity for all rivers.  The other tracers are` (2473); `!                optional.` (2474); `!                This logical switch REPLACES and ELIMINATES the need to have` (2476); `!                or read the variable "river_flag(river)" in the input rivers` (2477); `!                forcing NetCDF file:` (2478); `!                 double river_flag(river)` (2480); `!                        river_flag:long_name = "river runoff tracer flag"` (2481); `!                        river_flag:option_0 = "all tracers are off"` (2482); `!                        river_flag:option_1 = "only temperature"` (2483); `!                        river_flag:option_2 = "only salinity"` (2484); `!                        river_flag:option_3 = "both temperature and salinity"` (2485); `!                        river_flag:units = "nondimensional"` (2486); `!                The above variable was too cumbersome and complicated when` (2488); `!                additional tracers are considered. However, this change is` (2489); `!                backward compatible.` (2490); `!                The LtracerSrc switch will be used to activate the reading of` (2492); `!                respective tracer variable from input river forcing NetCDF` (2493); `!                file. If you want to add other tracer variables (other than` (2494); `!                temperature and salinity) as a source for a particular` (2495); `!                river(s), you just need to specify such values on those` (2496); `!                river(s). Then, set the values to ZERO on the other river(s)` (2497); `!                that do NOT require such river forcing for that tracer.` (2498); `!                Recall that you need to specify the tracer values for all` (2499); `!                rivers, even if their values are zero.` (2500). |
| 2502–2558 | 용어집 / 기후 평균장 처리 — NetCDF 또는 해석적 CPP 옵션의 기후 평균장을 설명한다(2503–2504). 해수면 기후 평균은 현재 사용하지 않고 향후 용도로 유지한다고 적는다(2507–2511). 질량·체적 보존을 위반하므로 자유수면 지배식의 너징을 허용하지 않고 필요하면 운동량식에 지정해야 한다고 적는다(2513–2521). 운동량·추적자 기후 평균의 완충·너징·혼합 용도와 조석 조정 조건 및 인덱스 예시를 제시한다(2523–2557). 원문: `! Logical switches to process climatology fields. The climatology fields are` (2503); `! either read from a NetCDF file or set with analytical CPP options.` (2504); `! LsshCLM      Logical switch (T/F) to process sea-surface height climatology.` (2507); `!                The CPP option ZCLIMATOLOGY is now obsolete and replaced with` (2508); `!                this switch to facilitate nesting applications. Currently,` (2509); `!                the sea-surface height climatology, CLIMA(ng)%ssh, is NOT` (2510); `!                used but it is kept for future use.` (2511); `!                The nudging of SSH on the free-surface governing equation` (2513); `!                (vertically integrated continuity equation) is NOT allowed` (2514); `!                because it violates mass/volume conservation. Recall that` (2515); `!                the time rate of change of free-surface is computed from the` (2516); `!                divergence of "ubar" and "vbar".  If such nudging term is` (2517); `!                required, it needs to be specified on the momentum equations` (2518); `!                for (u,v) and/or (ubar,vbar). If done on (u,v) only, its` (2519); `!                effects enter the 2D momentum equations via the residual` (2520); `!                vertically integrated forcing term.` (2521); `! Lm2CLM       Logical switch (T/F) to process 2D momentum (ubar, vbar)` (2523); `!                climatology. The CPP option M2CLIMATOLOGY is now obsolete` (2524); `!                and replaced with this switch to facilitate nesting` (2525); `!                applications. Currently, the CLIMA(ng)%ubarclm and` (2526); `!                CLIMA(ng)%vbarclm are used for sponges and nudging. If` (2527); `!                tidal forcing, the climatological values are adjusted to` (2528); `!                include tides.` (2529); `! Lm3CLM       Logical switch (T/F) to process 3D momentum climatology (u,v)` (2531); `!                The CPP option M3CLIMATOLOGY is now obsolete and replaced` (2532); `!                with this switch to facilitate nesting applications.` (2533); `!                Currently, the CLIMA(ng)%uclm and CLIMA(ng)%vclm are used` (2534); `!                for sponges and nudging.` (2535); `! LtracerCLM   Logical switches (T/F) to process active and inert tracer` (2537); `!                variables climatology.  The CPP option TCLIMATOLOGY is now` (2538); `!                obsolete and replaced with these switches to facilitate` (2539); `!                nesting applications. Currently, the CLIMA(ng)%tclm is` (2540); `!                used for horizontal mixing, sponges, and nudging.` (2541); `!                Only NAT active tracers (temperature, salinity) and NPT inert` (2543); `!                tracers need to be specified here:` (2544); `!                 LtracerCLM(itemp,ng)     for temperature (itemp=1)` (2546); `!                 LtracerCLM(isalt,ng)     for salinity    (isalt=2)` (2547); `!                 LtracerCLM(NAT+1,ng)     for inert tracer 1` (2548); `!                 ...                      ...` (2549); `!                 LtracerCLM(NAT+NPT,ng)   for inert tracer NPT` (2550); `!                Other biological and sediment tracers switches are specified` (2552); `!                in their respective input scripts.` (2553); `!                These switches also controls which climatology tracer fields` (2555); `!                (specially passive tracers) needs to be processed.  So we` (2556); `!                may reduce the memory allocation for the CLIMA(ng)%tclm array.` (2557). |
| 2559–2592 | 용어집 / 운동량 기후 평균 너징 — 2차원·3차원 운동량의 너징 스위치와 대체한 CPP 옵션을 정의한다(2563–2580). 필요한 기후 평균 데이터를 처리하는 별도 스위치도 켜야 한다고 적는다(2566–2570·2582–2586). 너징 계수는 `ANA_NUDGCOEF` 해석 함수 또는 `NUDNAME` 파일에서 읽는다고 적는다(2572–2575·2588–2591). 원문: `! Logical switches for nudging to climatology fields.` (2560); `! LnudgeM2CLM   Logical switch (T/F) to activate the nudging of 2D momentum` (2563); `!                 climatology.  The CPP option M2CLM_NUDGING is now obsolete` (2564); `!                 and replaced with this switch to facilitate nesting` (2565); `!                 applications.  Users also need to TURN ON the logical` (2566); `!                 switch "Lm2CLM", described above, to process the required` (2567); `!                 2D momentum climatology data.  This data can be set with` (2568); `!                 analytical functions (ANA_M2CLIMA) or read from input` (2569); `!                 climatology NetCDF file(s).` (2570); `!                 The nudging coefficients CLIMA(ng)%M2nudgcof can be set` (2572); `!                 with analytical functions in "ana_nudgcoef.h" using CPP` (2573); `!                 option ANA_NUDGCOEF. TCLM_NUDGING is now obsolete and replaced with these` (2596); `!                 switches to facilitate nesting applications.` (2597); `! It is advisable to limit the number of slices (NSLICE) to` (3133); `! a small value, ideally between 1 and 4, to keep the QUICKSAVE file size` (3134); `! manageable. | 3142–3173 | 용어집 / 사용자 매개변수 — 정수 사용자 매개변수 수와 실수 배열을 정의한다(3146–3151). `SANITY_CHECK`에서 섭동(perturbation)할 접선 선형·수반 상태변수와 격자 인덱스의 각 배열 항목을 제시한다(3153–3169). 같은 변수를 섭동하고 보고할 때 두 모델의 매개변수를 같은 값으로 두라고 적는다(3171–3172). 원문: `! | 3174–3199 | 용어집 / 입출력 라이브러리 선택 — WikiROMS 참조와 표준 NetCDF·PIO 라이브러리 선택을 설명한다(3175–3186). PIO 병렬 입출력은 MPI-IO를 사용하므로 분산 메모리(distributed-memory) 응용으로 제한한다고 적는다(3188–3189). 라이브러리 플래그 범위와 `INP_LIB`·`OUT_LIB` 정의를 제시한다(3191–3198). 원문: `! I/O options and parameters. A more complete description of the available` (3175); `! options can be found in WikiROMS (https://myroms.org/wiki/IO).` (3176); `! The ROMS input and output NetCDF files can be processed using the standard` (3179); `! NetCDF library developed by UNIDATA, the Parallel-IO (PIO) library developed` (3180); `! at NCAR. In addition to the standard NetCDF library, ROMS can be compiled` (3181); `! with either the PIO library. Check  www.myroms.org/wiki/External_Libraries` (3182); `! for more information on how to obtain and install these libraries. The user` (3183); `! has the choice to select which library is used to process input and output` (3184); `! NetCDF files. For parallel I/O, we recommend using the PIO library because` (3185); `! it is more efficient than other options in ROMS.` (3186); `! The Parallel I/O using the PIO library is restricted to distributed-memory` (3188); `! applications because it uses MPI-IO implementations like ROMIO.` (3189); `! * ROMS Input and Output NetCDF library to use flag: [1 or 2]` (3191); `!   [1] Standard NetCDF3 or NetCDF4 library (Unidata)` (3193); `!   [2] Serial/Parallel I/O using Paralle-IO (PIO) library (MPI applications)` (3194); `! INP_LIB      Reading library flag for input NetCDF files` (3196); `! OUT_LIB      Creation/writing library flag for output NetCDF files` (3198). |
| 3200–3216 | 용어집 / PIO 파일 형식·방법 — 읽기·쓰기 형식별 병렬·직렬 방법과 선택값을 제시한다(3200–3206). PIO 빌드에 따라 일부 유형을 사용할 수 없고 NetCDF가 병렬 입출력을 지원하지 않으면 두 방법을 사용할 수 없다고 적는다(3208–3211). CDF-5 사용 비권고와 직렬 쓰기 압축이 가능한 방법을 제시한다(3212–3215). 원문: `! * PIO method flag for reading/writing NetCDF files: [0,1,2,3,4]` (3200); `!   [0] parallel read and write of PnetCDF files (CDF-5 type)` (3202); `!   [1] parallel read and write of PnetCDF files (NetCDF3 64-bit offset type)` (3203); `!   [2] serial   read and write of NetCDF3 files (NetCDF3 64-bit offset type)` (3204); `!   [3] parallel read and serial write of NetCDF4/HDF5 files (NetCDF4 type)` (3205); `!   [4] parallel read and write of NETCDF4/HDF5 files (NetCDF4 type)` (3206); `! PIO_METHOD   PIO library file type for reading or writing. Depending on` (3208); `!                the build of the PIO library, not all the I/O types are` (3209); `!                available. If NetCDF library does not support parallel I/O,` (3210); `!                PIO_METHOD=3,4 are not available. Notice that we can create` (3211); `!                CDF-5 type PnetCDF files (PIO_METHOD=0), but it is not` (3212); `!                recommended because portability and post-processing` (3213); `!                constraints. Currently, NetCDF4/HDF5 data compression is` (3214); `!                possible with PIO_METHOD=3 during serial write.` (3215). |
| 3217–3255 | 용어집 / PIO 프로세스 구성 — 입출력 프로세스 수와 계산 영역 분할이 같을 때의 곱 조건, 적은 입출력 프로세스 권고를 제시한다(3219–3224). MPI 순위 간격·첫 작업 위치·집계자를 정의한다(3226–3231). 내부 통신(intra-communications)의 계산·입출력 겸용, 작업 시작 이동 및 하드웨어 노드 분산 권고를 설명한다(3233–3245). 비동기 외부 통신(inter-communications)의 전용 입출력 프로세스와 개발 중·사용 비권고 상태를 적는다(3247–3253). 원문: `! * PIO library processes set-up:` (3217); `! PIO_IOTASKS  Number of MPI processors used for I/O. If I/O decomposition is` (3219); `!                identical to the computational decomposition, PIO_IOTASK is` (3220); `!                equal to NtileI*NtileJ.  Typically, it is advantageous and` (3221); `!                highly recommended to define the I/O decomposition in smaller` (3222); `!                number of processes for efficiency and to avoid MPI` (3223); `!                communication bottlenecks.` (3224); `! PIO_STRIDE   Stride step in the MPI-rank between I/O tasks.` (3226); `! PIO_BASE     Offset for the first I/O task (usually, PIO_BASE=1).` (3228); `! PIO_AGGREG   Number of MPI-aggregators to use in intra-communication mode to` (3230); `!              improve MPI collective I/O performance.` (3231); `!              In intra-communications mode, all processors in OCN_COMM_WORLD` (3233); `!              are involved in computations. A subset or all processors does` (3234); `!              I/O (and also computations). The PIO_IOTASKS and PIO_STRIDE` (3235); `!              parameters specify the total number of I/O tasks and the stride` (3236); `!              between them with respect to the ROMS MPI-communicator object,` (3237); `!              OCN_COMM_WORLD. The optional PIO_BASE parameter is used to shift` (3238); `!              the first I/O task away from the first computational task. This` (3239); `!              is often desirable because the application's first computational` (3240); `!              task usually has higher memory requirements than other processes.` (3241); `!              If the MPI-processes are spread over several hardware nodes, it` (3242); `!              is highly recommended to use a value for PIO_STRIDE that scatters` (3243); `!              the I/O processes over all nodes.  Avoid all the I/O processes` (3244); `!              occupying the same node.` (3245); `!              In the inter-communications (asynchronous) mode, the I/O tasks` (3247); `!              are a disjointed set of dedicated I/O processes and do not` (3248); `!              perform computations. It is possible to have several groups of` (3249); `!              computational units running separate models (coupling) where` (3250); `!              all the I/O data are sent to dedicated processes. Asynchronous` (3251); `!              I/O is still under development and not recommended for use at` (3252); `!              this time.` (3253). |
| 3256–3289 | 용어집 / PIO 재배치·통신 — Box·Subset 방법의 선택값을 제시한다(3256–3264). Box 방법은 전체간(all-to-all) MPI 통신을 요구하고 한 타일이 여러 입출력 프로세스로 보낼 수 있다고 적는다(3266–3271). Subset 방법은 고유 입출력 프로세스로 보내며 저장 장치 통신은 증가할 수 있으나 전체간 MPI 통신을 요구하지 않는다고 적는다(3273–3279). 점대점·집합 통신과 일부 시스템의 효율 설명을 포함한다(3281–3288). 원문: `! * PIO rearranger methods for moving data between computational and I/O` (3256); `!   processes:` (3257); `!   [1] Box rearrangement` (3259); `!   [2] Subset rearrangement` (3260); `! PIO_REARR    Rearrangement method between computational and I/O processes. It` (3262); `!                provides the ability to rearrange data between computational` (3263); `!                and parallel I/O decompositions.` (3264); `!              In the box method, data is rearranged from computational to I/O` (3266); `!              processes in a continuous manner to the data ordering in the` (3267); `!              file. Since the ordering of data between computational and I/O` (3268); `!              partitions may be different, the rearrangement will require` (3269); `!              all-to-all MPI communications. Also, notice that each computing` (3270); `!              tile may transfer data to one or more I/O processes.` (3271); `!              In the subset method, each I/O process is associated with a` (3273); `!              subset of computing processes. The computing tile sends its data` (3274); `!              to a unique I/O process. The data on I/O processes may be more` (3275); `!              fragmented to the ordering on disk, which may increase the` (3276); `!              communications to the storage medium. However, the rearrangement` (3277); `!              scales better since all-to-all MPI communications are not` (3278); `!              required.` (3279); `! * PIO rearranger MPI communication flag:` (3281); `!   [0] Point-to-Point (basic send/receive individual operations)` (3283); `!   [1] Collective (high-level gather/scatter grouped operations)` (3284); `! PIO_REARRCOM  Type of communications between computational to I/O processes.` (3286); `!               In some systems with a generic MPI library implementation, the` (3287); `!               Point-to-Point communications are more efficient.` (3288). |
| 3290–3320 | 용어집 / PIO 방향 제어·전송 옵션 — 방향 제어 플래그의 값과 뜻을 제시한다(3290–3297). 과도한 메시지가 버퍼(buffer) 공간을 소진할 수 있고 수신자가 준비되고 자원이 충분할 때 PIO가 전송한다고 적는다(3299–3305). 계산·입출력 양방향의 핸드셰이크·MPI 전송·대기 요청 상한을 정의한다(3307–3319). 원문: `! * PIO rearranger MPI communications direction control flag:` (3290); `!   [0] Enable computational to I/O processes, and vice versa` (3292); `!   [1] Enable computational to I/O processes only` (3293); `!   [2] Enable I/O to computational processes only` (3294); `!   [3] Disable flow control` (3295); `! PIO_REARRDIR Flow control algorithm between computational and I/O processes:` (3297); `!              Optimally, MPI communications should be designed to send a modest` (3299); `!              number messages evenly distributed across a number of processes.` (3300); `!              An excessive number of messages to a single MPI-process can` (3301); `!              exhaust the buffer space which can affect efficiency or failure` (3302); `!              due to the slowdown in the retransmitting of dropped messages.` (3303); `!              PIO only send messages (Isend) when the receiver is ready and` (3304); `!              has sufficient resources.` (3305); `! * PIO rearranger options for communications from computational to I/O` (3307); `!   processes (C2I):` (3308); `! PIO_C2I_HS   Logical switch (T/F) to enable C2I exchange handshake` (3310); `! PIO_C2I_Send Logical switch (T/F) to enable C2I MPI-Isends` (3311); `! PIO_C2I_Preq Maximum pending C2I requests` (3312); `! * PIO rearranger options for communications from I/O to computational` (3314); `!   processes (I2C):` (3315); `! PIO_I2C_HS   Logical switch (T/F) to enable I2C exchange handshake` (3317); `! PIO_I2C_Send Logical switch (T/F) to enable I2C MPI-Isends` (3318); `! PIO_I2C_Preq Maximum pending I2C requests` (3319). |
| 3321–3341 | 용어집 / NetCDF 압축 — HDF5·DEFLATE CPP 옵션과 라이브러리 컴파일 조건을 제시한다(3321–3325). 병렬 쓰기에서 압축을 사용할 수 없다는 원문 설명과 외부 참조를 그대로 포함한다(3325–3330). shuffle·deflate 필터의 비영 조건과 정수 압축 수준 범위를 제시한다(3332–3340). 원문: `! * NetCDF-4/HDF5 compression parameters for output files:` (3321); `!   This capability is used when both HDF5 and DEFLATE C-preprocessing` (3323); `!   options are  activated. The user needs to compile with the NetCDF-4` (3324); `!   (HDF5) and MPI libraries. File deflation cannot be used in parallel` (3325); `!   I/O for writing because the compression makes it impossible for the` (3326); `!   HDF5 library to exactly map the data to the disk location.  For more` (3327); `!   information, check NetCDF official website:` (3328); `!   www.unidata.ucar.edu/software/netcdf` (3330); `! NC_SHUFFLE   Shuffle filter integer flag. If non-zero, turn on shuffle` (3332); `!                filter.` (3333); `! | 3342–3372 | 용어집 / 격자 추출·간추림 — `GRID_EXTRACT` 적용 조건과 추출 플래그의 값별 뜻을 제시한다(3343–3352). 현재 사용해야 하는 표본 배율(sampling factor)과 두 `MOD` 조건식을 그대로 옮긴다(3354–3359). 분할 4D-Var 내부 반복의 낮은 해상도 활용, 엇갈림(staggered) 속도 변수의 단순 평균과 육지·바다 마스킹(land/sea masking) 제약을 설명한다(3361–3367). 추출 격자는 상위 격자 안에 들어가야 한다고 적는다(3369–3371). 원문: `! If GRID_EXTRACT is activated, set extraction parameters.` (3343); `!  ExtracFlag  Flag to extract and write history solution into the EXTRACT` (3346); `!                file at the desired grid geometry by decimation or horizontal` (3347); `!                interpolation:` (3348); `!                ExtractFlag = 0         No extraction` (3350); `!                ExtractFlag = 1         Extract via horizontal interpolation` (3351); `!                ExtractFlag > 2         Extract via coarsening by decimation` (3352); `!              If decimation, ExtracTFlag is the sampling factor. For now, you` (3354); `!              must use ExtractFlag=2 so data is written at every other point.` (3355); `!              Notice that it is required to satisfy the following criteria:` (3356); `!                MOD(Lm+1, ExtractFlag) = 0` (3358); `!                MOD(Mm+1, ExtractFlag) = 0` (3359); `!              Grid decimation is intended for the split 4D-Var algorithms to` (3361); `!              facilitate running the inner loops at coarser resolution to` (3362); `!              accelerate the computations. The advantage of ExtractFlag=2 is` (3363); `!              that it is very trivial to decimate the staggered U- and` (3364); `!              V-variables with a simple average. Also, we need to consider` (3365); `!              special rules in the land/sea masking that limit its use to` (3366); `!              other ExtractFlag values.` (3367); `!  GRXNAME     Input extract grid geometry NetCDF filename. It must be created` (3369); `!                with tools similar to the ROMS application grid and contained` (3370); `!                inside the parent grid (GRDNAME).` (3371). |

| 3415–3453 | 용어집 / 중첩 접촉점·경계 파일 예시 — 접촉점 파일의 생성 스크립트와 WikiROMS 참조를 제시한다(3415–3428). 경계 파일 수와 격자별 파일명을 정의하고 목록에서 필요한 변수의 첫 파일을 읽으므로 순서가 중요하다고 적는다(3431–3444). 물리·생물 경계장과 연도별 파일을 연결하는 수·파일명·연속행 예시를 그대로 옮긴다(3446–3451). 원문: `! Nesting grids connectivity data:` (3415); `!  NGCNAME     Input nested grids contact points information filename. This` (3417); `!                NetCDF file is currently generated using script:` (3418); `!                matlab/grid/contact.m` (3420); `!                from the ROMS Matlab repository. See` (3423); `!                https://www.myroms.org/wiki/index.php/Nested_Grids` (3425); `!                https://www.myroms.org/wiki/index.php/Grid_Processing_Scripts` (3426); `!                for more information.` (3428); `! The USER has the option to enter several filenames for the lateral` (3437); `!  boundary conditions variables and or split input data time records for` (3438); `!  each nested grid. For example, the USER may have different files for` (3439); `!  physical, biology, and sediment state variables. The model will scan` (3440); `!  the file list and will read the needed data from the first file in the` (3441); `!  list containing the lateral boundary variable. Therefore, the order of` (3442); `!  the filenames is critical. It is also possible to split input data` (3443); `!  time records into several NetCDF files.` (3444); `!    NBCFILES == 2                            ! number of boundary files` (3446); `!     BRYNAME == my_physics_bry_year1.nc \|    ! physical kernel variables` (3448); `!                my_physics_bry_year2.nc \` (3449); `!                my_biology_bry_year1.nc \|    ! biological tracers` (3450); `!                my_biology_bry_year2.nc` (3451). |

Input climatology file(s) name:` (3454); `!  NCLMFILES   Number of unique climatology files per nested grid.` (3456); `!  CLMNAME     Input climatology data filename(s) per nested grid.` (3458); `! For example, the USER may have different files for physical, biology,` (3462); `!  and sediment state variables. The model will scan the file list and` (3463); `!  will read the needed data from the first file in the list containing` (3464); `!  the lateral climatology variable. Therefore, the order of the filenames` (3465); `!  is critical. It is also possible to split input data time records into` (3466); `!  several NetCDF files.` (3467); `! 집계: 원문 3578행, 판독 구간 126개, 옮긴 계산식·관계식 43개, 옮긴 설정 매개변수 614개, 연 그림 0개, 확인된 사실 26항목. 계산식·관계식은 원문에 쓰인 계산 표현의 발생 건수로 세며 연속행으로 이어진 식은 하나로 센다. 같은 식이 다른 행에 다시 나오면 별도 발생으로 센다. 단순 상수 설정값·선택 조건·범위·배열 인덱스·이차항의 이름은 수식 수에 넣지 않는다. 설정 매개변수는 주석이 아닌 설정행의 서로 다른 키워드를 괄호 안 식별자까지 포함하여 센다. 주석 속 예시는 이 수에 추가하지 않는다. 본문 인용은 이 집계 대상 외의 설명 주석·조건·범위·예시도 포함한다.

수식 집계의 원문 행: 1101·1102·1267·1268·1296·1299·1322·1328·1371·1598·1641·1642·1792·1804·1910·1911·1930·1931·2047·2050·2053·2056·2154·2158·2163·2167·2184–2186·2191·2195·2197·2199–2200·2205·2209–2210·2212–2213·2215·2220·2224·2239–2240·2344–2345·2346·2404–2405·3358·3359행. 원문에는 이미지 지시문이나 이미지 파일명이 없으며 외부 문서 도식·곡선의 설명과 ASCII 도식은 본문에 인용했다.

## 판독 중 확인된 사실 (판단 아님, 후속 검토 대상)

- 647–648·773–774·877–878행: `idUair`·`idVair`의 출력 변수 이름 주석은 HISTORY·AVERAGE에서 `Uwind`·`Vwind`이고 QUICKSAVE에서 `Uair`·`Vair`이다. 실제 NetCDF 변수 이름은 이번 판독에서 확인하지 않았다.
- 582–583·897–900행: HISTORY의 `id3dPV` 이름 주석은 `pvorticity`, `id3dRV` 이름 주석은 `rvorticity`이다. AVERAGE의 `id3dRV`·`id3dPV` 이름 주석은 각각 `pvorticity`·`rvorticity`이다. AVERAGE의 설명 주석은 각각 `relative vorticity`·`potential vorticity`라고 적는다. 같은 구간의 2차원 항목도 `id2dRV`에 `pvorticity_bar`, `id2dPV`에 `rvorticity_bar`라고 적는다.
- 11–12·73–74·1244–1246·1252–1253·1311–1313행: 서두는 입력 매개변수를 `ANY order`로 입력할 수 있다고 적는다. 뒤 설명은 변수 정보 파일을 먼저 처리해야 한다고 적는다. 중첩 격자 수는 다른 모든 매개변수보다 먼저 읽어야 한다고 적는다. 격자 차원도 먼저 읽어야 한다고 적는다. 각 선행 처리 요구의 관계는 이번 원문에 별도로 정리되어 있지 않다.
- 1267–1268행: 층별 격자 수의 합 조건은 `SUM(GridsInLayer)    = Ngrids`라고 적는다. 배열 길이 조건의 함수 표기는 `LENGHT(GridsInLayer) = NestLayers`라고 적는다.
- 231·248·1602–1618행: `Nintervals` 설명은 `It must be a multiple of NTIMES.`라고 적는다(1603). 현재 입력은 `NTIMES == 1440`와 `Nintervals =  1`이다(231·248). 같은 설명의 분할 예시는 `Nintervals=3`에 `NTIMES/3`와 `2*NTIMES/3`를 사용한다(1606–1618).
- 1714–1718행: 새 EXTRACT 파일 생성 간격의 키워드는 `NDEFXTR`이다. 생성 간격의 마지막 설명은 `every EXTRACT timesteps`라고 적는다(1717–1718). 이 파일에는 시간 간격 수 매개변수 `EXTRACT`의 정의가 없다.
- 1773–1776행: `LcycleADJ`는 수반 출력 파일의 기록 순환 스위치라고 적는다. FALSE 분기의 저장 대상은 `all tangent linear fields`라고 적는다.
- 1871–1893행: 운동량 점성 키워드는 `VISC2`·`VISC4`·`ad_VISC2`·`ad_VISC4`이다. 가변 점성 조건의 설명은 `UVNU2`·`UVNU4`·`ad_UVNU2`·`ad_UVNU4`라는 이름을 사용한다(1873·1878·1883·1890). 이 파일에는 이 네 이름의 별도 정의가 없다.
- 1919–1937행: `LtracerSponge` 설명은 수평 확산계수와 `diff_factor`를 다룬다. 해석 함수 설명은 `horizontal viscosity`와 `LuvSponge`를 적는다(1933–1937).
- 2161–2167행: `Vtransform=2`의 깊이식은 `z(x,y,s,t)=zeta(x,y,t)*[zeta(x,y,t)+h(x,y)]*Zo(x,y,s)`라고 적는다(2163). 첫 `zeta`와 대괄호 항을 곱셈으로 연결한다. 식을 교정하지 않고 옮겼다.
- 2197·2254–2256행: 두 번째 신축 함수의 저면식은 `Cbot(s)=-1+[1-SINH(theta_b*(s+1))]/SINH(theta_b)`라고 적는다(2197). 뒤 일반 신축 조건은 `C(-1)=-1`이라고 적는다(2256). 두 표기를 모두 원문 그대로 옮겼다.
- 2215행: `Cweight=0.5*(1-TANH(Hscale*(s+0.5))`에는 여는 소괄호가 닫는 소괄호보다 하나 많다. 이 식을 닫는 다음 연속행은 없다.
- 2344–2345행: `tide_start`의 두 줄 식은 `Rclock%tide_DateNumber(2) -`와 `Rclock%DateNumber(2))`로 이어진다. 닫는 소괄호가 여는 소괄호보다 하나 많다.
- 451–455·2377·2392–2396행: `OBCFAC > 1`이면 유입 너징이 유출보다 강하다고 적는다(452–453·2395–2396). 뒤 설명은 유입 너징 시간 척도를 유출 값에 `OBCFAC`를 곱하여 얻는다고 적는다(2393–2395). 역시간 척도의 내부 계산도 적혀 있다(2377). 이 배율의 실제 구현은 이번 판독에서 확인하지 않았다.
- 668·794·2801·2922행: 입력부 `Hout(idMtls)`·`Qout(idMtls)`의 설명은 `turbulent length scale`이다(668·794). 용어집의 같은 두 항목은 `turbulent kinetic energy times length scale`이라고 적는다(2801·2922).
- 3082–3083행: `Dout(M3yvis)`의 설명행이 같은 내용으로 연속 두 번 적혀 있다.
- 954–956·3071–3084행: 입력부에는 `Dout(M3vadv)`·`Dout(M3hrad)`·`Dout(M3vrad)` 설정행이 있다(954–956). 용어집의 3차원 운동량 진단 목록에는 이 세 항목의 설명행이 없다(3071–3084).
- 3127–3140행: 절 제목은 `Generic User parameters.`이다(3127). 이 절 본문은 `NSLICE`·`Z_SLICE`와 일정 수심 절편을 설명한다(3130–3140). 같은 제목은 실제 `NUSER`·`USER` 설명 앞에도 적혀 있다(3143–3148).
- 1064–1067·3292–3295행: `PIO_REARRDIR` 선택값 표는 입력부에서 양방향·계산에서 입출력으로·입출력에서 계산으로·제어 해제를 각각 `0`·`2`·`3`·`4`로 적는다. 용어집은 같은 네 뜻을 각각 `0`·`1`·`2`·`3`으로 적는다.
- 1093–1102·3350–3359행: 입력부는 `ExtractFlag > 1`을 간추림 조건으로 적는다(1095). 용어집은 `ExtractFlag > 2`를 간추림 조건으로 적는다(3352). 같은 용어집은 현재 `ExtractFlag=2`를 반드시 사용하라고 적는다(3354–3355).
- 3219–3221행: 프로세스 수 키워드는 `PIO_IOTASKS`이다(3219). 계산 분할과 같은 경우의 설명은 끝의 S가 없는 `PIO_IOTASK`를 사용한다(3220–3221). 이 파일에는 `PIO_IOTASK`의 별도 정의가 없다.
- 1104·3346·3350–3355행: 입력 키워드는 `ExtractFlag`이다(1104). 용어집 항목 제목의 표기는 `ExtracFlag`이다(3346). 같은 항목 본문은 `ExtractFlag`와 `ExtracTFlag` 표기를 사용한다(3350–3355).
- 1118–1125·3394–3404행: `FOInameA`·`FOInameB`는 상태 공간 예측 오차 척도에서 사용하는 수반 강제력 파일이라고 적는다(1118–1121·3394–3398). 이어지는 항목 설명은 이 두 이름을 각각 `Forecast initialized with 4D-Var analysis`와 `Forecast initialized with 4D_Var background`라고 적는다(3402·3404).
- 3471–3474행: 기후 평균 `CLMNAME` 예시의 첫 파일은 `my_physics_clm_year1.nc`이다(3471). 나머지 세 파일명은 `my_physics_bry_year2.nc`·`my_biology_bry_year1.nc`·`my_biology_bry_year2.nc`이다(3472–3474).
- 2199–2200·2209–2215행: 신축 함수의 식은 `alpha`·`beta`·`Hscale`을 사용한다. 이 파일에는 이 세 기호의 별도 정의나 값이 없다.
- 524·534·538·553·557·2651·2666·2670·2683·2687행: 추적자 배열 크기 설명에 `NT`가 쓰여 있다. 이 파일에는 `NAT`·`NPT`·`NCS`·`NNS`의 정의는 있으나 `NT`의 별도 정의는 없다.
